WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN orderexecutions AS e
    ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
), shares AS (
  SELECT execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM type_counts
), above_average AS (
  SELECT execution_count, share
  FROM (
    SELECT execution_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM (
      SELECT execution_count,
             execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share
      FROM type_counts
    )
  )
  WHERE share > average_share
)
SELECT SUM(execution_count) AS sum_counts,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;
